description: This file provides API utility functions for interacting with a backend service, including CRUD operations for work items, comments, and other resources. It handles HTTP requests with proper error handling and token-based authentication headers.

methods.name: withAuthHeaders(extra = {})
methods.description: Builds headers for fetch requests, adding Authorization header if token is available

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request to the backend and returns the parsed JSON response, throws on errors

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON POST request to the backend and returns the parsed JSON response, throws on errors

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters and returns parsed JSON, throws on errors

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a JSON PATCH request to the backend and returns parsed JSON, throws on errors

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item via GET endpoint

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null })
methods.description: Adds a new comment to a specific work item via POST endpoint

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Fetches list of work items, possibly filtered by project ID

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item with specified attributes

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific work item

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Constructs full URL from a given path based on current API base
